name: Lombard Street Crooked Block - San Francisco
scope: Iconic crooked Lombard Street block between Hyde Street (top/west) and Leavenworth Street (bottom/east), plus immediate intersections and bordering context.

coordinate_frame.anchor: Hyde Street / Lombard Street centerline intersection, OSM node 65360287
coordinate_frame.vertical_zero: Hyde/Lombard class-2 LiDAR median ground elevation

orientation.vertical: NAVD88 relative to Hyde/Lombard top control

microblocks.policy: Use dense microblocks for curved roads, fractional grade, curbs, stairs, hedge/planter edges and thin civic geometry; full blocks for bulk terrain.

constraints: No invented house facade detail in L1.
Terrain and hardscape must be source-traceable before surrounding building massing.
review_rule: Do not generate L2 house geometry until user approves L1 v002 terrain, road, stairs, retaining edges and overall scale in Minecraft.
